title: First Notice of Loss — motor accident
description: Initial claim report for a car accident, captured from a phone call.

policy_number.description: Insurance policy number as stated by the caller (e.g. FNX-204518). Verify with lookup_policy.

x-question.en: Could you give me your policy number? It is on your insurance certificate and starts with three letters.
x-question.fr: Pourriez-vous me donner votre numéro de contrat ? Il figure sur votre attestation d'assurance et commence par trois lettres.
x-question.ar: هل يمكنك أن تعطيني رقم وثيقة التأمين؟ ستجده في شهادة التأمين ويبدأ بثلاثة أحرف.

x-question.en: Can you confirm the full name of the policyholder?
x-question.fr: Pouvez-vous me confirmer le nom complet de l'assuré ?
x-question.ar: هل يمكنك تأكيد الاسم الكامل للمؤمَّن له؟

incident_datetime.description: When the accident happened, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, local time). Resolve relative expressions such as 'yesterday at 5pm' against the call date.

x-question.en: On what date and at roughly what time did the accident happen?
x-question.fr: À quelle date et vers quelle heure l'accident a-t-il eu lieu ?
x-question.ar: في أي تاريخ وحوالي أي ساعة وقع الحادث؟

incident_location.description: Where the accident happened (street, city, landmark).

x-question.en: Where exactly did the accident take place — street and city?
x-question.fr: Où exactement l'accident s'est-il produit — rue et ville ?
x-question.ar: أين وقع الحادث بالضبط — الشارع والمدينة؟

vehicle_plate.description: Registration plate of the insured vehicle. French SIV format AB-123-CD or Moroccan format 12345-A-6 (digits-letter-region).

x-question.en: What is the registration plate of your vehicle?
x-question.fr: Quelle est l'immatriculation de votre véhicule ?

damage_description.description: Short description of the damage to the insured vehicle.

x-question.en: Can you describe the damage to your vehicle?
x-question.fr: Pouvez-vous décrire les dommages sur votre véhicule ?
x-question.ar: هل يمكنك وصف الأضرار التي لحقت بسيارتك؟

x-question.en: Was anyone injured in the accident, even slightly?
x-question.fr: Y a-t-il eu des blessés, même légers ?
x-question.ar: هل أصيب أي شخص في الحادث، ولو بشكل طفيف؟

injury_details.description: Who was injured and how. Required when injuries_reported is true.

x-question.en: Who was injured, and what kind of injuries were they?
x-question.fr: Qui a été blessé et de quel type de blessures s'agit-il ?

third_party_involved.description: Whether another vehicle or party was involved.

x-question.en: Was another vehicle or person involved in the accident?
x-question.fr: Un autre véhicule ou une autre personne était-il impliqué ?
x-question.ar: هل كانت هناك سيارة أخرى أو شخص آخر متورط في الحادث؟

third_party_name.description: Name of the other driver / party.

x-question.en: Do you have the name of the other driver?
x-question.fr: Avez-vous le nom de l'autre conducteur ?

third_party_plate.description: Registration plate of the other vehicle (FR or MA format).

x-question.en: Did you note the registration plate of the other vehicle?
x-question.fr: Avez-vous relevé l'immatriculation de l'autre véhicule ?
x-question.ar: هل سجلت رقم لوحة السيارة الأخرى؟

third_party_insurer.description: Insurance company of the other party.

x-question.en: Do you know which company insures the other vehicle?
x-question.fr: Savez-vous quelle compagnie assure l'autre véhicule ?
x-question.ar: هل تعرف شركة التأمين الخاصة بالسيارة الأخرى؟

police_report_filed.description: Whether the police attended or a police report was filed.

x-question.en: Did the police come to the scene, or has a police report been filed?
x-question.fr: La police est-elle intervenue ou un procès-verbal a-t-il été établi ?
x-question.ar: هل حضرت الشرطة إلى مكان الحادث أو تم تحرير محضر؟

police_report_number.description: Police report reference, if one was given. Required when police_report_filed is true.

x-question.en: Do you have the police report reference number?
x-question.ar: هل لديك الرقم المرجعي لمحضر الشرطة؟

witnesses.description: People who saw the accident. Empty list if the caller said there were none.

x-question.en: Were there any witnesses? If so, do you have their names and phone numbers?
x-question.fr: Y avait-il des témoins ? Si oui, avez-vous leurs noms et numéros de téléphone ?
x-question.ar: هل كان هناك شهود؟ إذا كان الأمر كذلك، هل لديك أسماؤهم وأرقام هواتفهم؟

callback_number.description: Phone number to call the caller back on. French (06 12 34 56 78 / +33…), Moroccan (06 61 23 45 67 / +212…) or international E.164.

x-question.en: What is the best phone number to reach you on?
x-question.fr: À quel numéro pouvons-nous vous rappeler ?
x-question.ar: ما هو أفضل رقم هاتف للتواصل معك؟
